scenes.title: Two moves east
scenes.viewerPurpose: An irrelevant museum fact changes no coordinate, giving children a simple test of relevance.

Composing the two moves makes the relationship visible.

scenes.title: Different subjects, shared habits
scenes.viewerPurpose: The same habit is to keep every relevant condition visible before concluding.
addOrChange: Later tasks combine route constraints, historical evidence, civic rules, and environmental flows.
A majority may still fail a stated quorum; a renewable resource can still be depleted.
